blurb: Africa Adventure Consultants specializes in customized and small group safaris in Africa, offering expert planning and 24/7 support. They provide trips that include wildlife viewing, chimpanzee trekking, and luxury accommodations in private reserves. Their safaris include full-board accommodation, ground transportation, guides, park fees, and conservation donations.
